text:
maria: Quick sync — StitchPoint asked for a private-deploy pilot next quarter. They want 99.9% SLA and <150ms median generate latency at ~2k QPS. Need to map cross-team deps and minimum launch criteria.

devon: Got it. Is this a committed customer (paid) ask or exploratory pilot? That changes scope.

maria: Paid pilot. Legal attached a KMS/HSM requirement and audit log retention request. They want a narrow rollout (5 tenants) initially.

sam: Infra notes: reserved capacity recommended (estimate 4x A100 equiv), VPC peering + NAT, route table + BGP config. Also need VPN creds and KMS integration window. Prewarm jobs for GPUs during business hours.

alex: Security: KMS integration + audit logs are mandatory. We also need an IAM review, threat model signoff, and a short pen-test window before GA. If they insist on HSM, timeline extends.

linda: From runtime/eng: to hit <150ms we need: adaptive batching tuned, prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts, and a canary path to test gptq-8bit fallback. Also a rollout flag for model-variant routing. Estimate ~3 sprints to build + test.

devon: On batching/caching: I can prototype an adaptive batcher and a cache policy. In load tests we shaved median from 180ms -> ~120ms after tuning. Canary will validate in staging.

maria: Proposed launch criteria (draft): 1) Customer acceptance test (latency & correctness), 2) Security signoff (IAM/KMS/pen-test), 3) Infra reserved & peered, 4) Canary in staging for 72h with rollback playbook, 5) Runbook + oncall handoff, 6) Cost estimate approved. Any objections?

alex: Add: KMS audit logs retained 90d for pilot, and SOC2 control mapping for tenant isolation. Can't sign off without IAM review scheduled.

sam: Infra checklist (quick):
```
- Reserve 4 GPUs (A100 equiv) for pilot
- Create VPC peering + route table rules
- Provision KMS key + access policy
- Staging network mirror + test traffic generator
```
I'll confirm exact SKUs by EOD Fri.

linda: Dependency callouts: Eng needs staging GPUs + network mirror by 2026-05-10 to avoid slipping the launch. Also need model-variant rollout flag and canary infra (small weight router).

devon: Action items I can take: own adaptive-batcher prototype, implement prefix cache, and run staging load tests. Linda: can you own the rollout flag + canary wiring?

linda: Yup I can own rollout flag + canary wiring.

sam: Confirming: reserving 4xA100 equiv for pilot, VPC peering scheduled Tue, KMS key provisioning queued (waiting on IAM policy from alex).

maria: I'll create the launch playbook doc and a short tracker. Will also circulate the acceptance test plan to StitchPoint. Inviting all of you to the kickoff Thursday. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Reminder: create Jira epic STITCH-PRIV-PILOT and link infra/story tickets to it.

alex: I'll schedule IAM review for Monday and a quick threats session Tue.

linda: ack :thumbsup:

devon: ack :white_check_mark:

sam: ack — will update infra checklist once SKUs confirmed.

maria: Thanks team — I'll post the initial playbook link in this thread when it's up and assign owners.
